label: A joint concrete V4-style proposal reconstruction over the reused two-coordinate language
summary: A joint concrete V4-style proposal reconstruction over the reused two-coordinate language. Import exact factorization to prove expressive membership iff exact classification through the retained representation; prove Boolean closure and analytic inclusion. Empirical representation uniquely minimizes retained-channel cost for the first-coordinate task, but cannot classify the hidden-coordinate task, for which expanded representation is uniquely adequate. Included contingent content and a tautology coexist with exclusion of hidden content and its negation, none object-language evaluations, and opposite ambient truth at equal-data worlds under the same adopted empirical proposal. Compose the existing verdict-silent theorem. These are bounded model facts and counterexamples to extra bridges, not a defeat, a full historical Carnap model, or root-premise truth. Rejected duplicate Church investigation: CHURCH-1949-TRIVIALIZATION and its nonvacuity/negation-closure results already deliver the requested logical step. Rejected arbitrary practical score matrix: actual representation adequacy and retained-coordinate complexity now determine choice. Historical prose records are orientation only, not premises silently identified with this reconstruction. Original V4 defeat-bridge search remains blocked; this model supplies none of its missing philosophical assumptions.
